semantics.alias_rule: fresh output with no storage alias to the YCbCr input
semantics.shape_rule: preserves rank and shape and requires exactly three channels at the canonical third-from-final channel axis
semantics.accumulation_dtype: F32 affine channel transform followed by F32 clamp
semantics.layout_rule: logical strided color reads and contiguous output in the input logical shape
semantics.device_rule: CPU ordinal zero on the input stream; other native devices fail typed
semantics.numeric_rule: Kornia 0.8.2 JPEG YCbCr inverse using 1.403, 0.714, 0.344, and 1.773 followed by channel clamp to [0,1]
semantics.determinism: fixed pixel and channel traversal with fixed affine order
semantics.cancellation_points: before validation, at bounded pixel intervals, and before publication
semantics.vjp_rule: transpose affine Jacobian with zero derivative for channels outside the clamp interval
semantics.jvp_rule: affine Jacobian applied to the input tangent with zero derivative for channels outside the clamp interval
